import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 10000000;
    static final int N = 210;
    static final int M = 21000;

    static class MaxFlow {
        static class Edge {
            int v, w;
        }

        Edge[] edge = new Edge[M];
        int[] adj = new int[M];
        int[] head = new int[N];
        int e;
        int[] dist = new int[N];
        int[] arc = new int[N];
        int[] gap = new int[N];
        int[] inq = new int[N];
        int[] pre = new int[N];

        void init() {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) head[i] = -1;
            e = 0;
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int w) {
            if (edge[e] == null) edge[e] = new Edge();
            edge[e].v = v; edge[e].w = w; adj[e] = head[u]; head[u] = e++;
            if (edge[e] == null) edge[e] = new Edge();
            edge[e].v = u; edge[e].w = 0; adj[e] = head[v]; head[v] = e++;
        }

        int sap(int s, int t) {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) arc[i] = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) pre[i] = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) inq[i] = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) gap[i] = 0;

            int[] q = new int[N * 2];
            int qf = 0, qr = 0;
            q[qr++] = t;
            inq[t] = 1;
            gap[0]++;
            dist[t] = 0;

            while (qf < qr) {
                int u = q[qf++];
                for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = adj[i]) {
                    int v = edge[i].v;
                    if (inq[v] == 0) {
                        q[qr++] = v;
                        inq[v] = 1;
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                        gap[dist[v]]++;
                        arc[v] = head[v];
                    }
                }
            }

            int low = INF, u = s, ans = 0;
            pre[s] = s;

            while (dist[s] < t) {
                boolean flag = false;
                for (int i = arc[u]; i != -1; i = adj[i]) {
                    if (edge[i].w > 0 && dist[edge[i].v] + 1 == dist[u]) {
                        flag = true;
                        low = Math.min(low, edge[i].w);
                        pre[edge[i].v] = u;
                        u = edge[i].v;
                        if (u == t) {
                            while (u != s) {
                                u = pre[u];
                                edge[arc[u]].w -= low;
                                edge[arc[u] ^ 1].w += low;
                            }
                            ans += low;
                            low = INF;
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (flag) continue;

                int mindis = t + 1;
                for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = adj[i]) {
                    if (edge[i].w > 0 && mindis > dist[edge[i].v]) {
                        mindis = dist[edge[i].v];
                        arc[u] = i;
                    }
                }
                gap[dist[u]]--;
                if (gap[dist[u]] == 0) return ans;
                dist[u] = mindis + 1;
                gap[dist[u]]++;
                u = pre[u];
            }
            return ans;
        }
    }

    static MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow();
    static int S, T;
    static char[][] str = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] str2 = new char[12][12];
    static int[][] sci = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] ca = new int[12][12];
    static int[][][] stone = new int[62][12][12];
    static int[][][][][] dp = new int[62][12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] dir = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int n, t;

    static void expand() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= t; ++k) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                    if (stone[k-1][i][j] == 1) {
                        stone[k][i][j] = 1;
                    } else if (stone[k-1][i][j] == 2) {
                        stone[k][i][j] = 2;
                    } else {
                        for (int z = 0; z < 4; ++z) {
                            int nx = i + dir[z][0];
                            int ny = j + dir[z][1];
                            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n) {
                                if (stone[k-1][nx][ny] == 2) {
                                    stone[k][i][j] = 2;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][] vis = new int[12][12];

    static void dfs(int x, int y, int nowx, int nowy, int k) {
        vis[nowx][nowy] = 1;
        dp[k][x][y][nowx][nowy] = 1;
        if (k >= t || stone[k][nowx][nowy] != 0) return;
        for (int z = 0; z < 4; ++z) {
            int nx = nowx + dir[z][0];
            int ny = nowy + dir[z][1];
            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n && vis[nx][ny] == 0) {
                if (stone[k][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
                dfs(x, y, nx, ny, k + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                str[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (str[i][j] == 'Z') stone[0][i][j] = 2;
                else if (str[i][j] == 'Y') stone[0][i][j] = 1;
                else sci[i][j] = str[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                str2[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (str2[i][j] >= '0' && str2[i][j] <= '9')
                    ca[i][j] = str2[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }

        expand();

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int a = 0; a < 12; a++) for (int b = 0; b < 12; b++) vis[a][b] = 0;
                    dfs(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }

        for (int k = 1; k <= t; ++k)
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x)
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y)
                    for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx)
                        for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny)
                            dp[k][x][y][nx][ny] += dp[k-1][x][y][nx][ny];

        mf.init();
        S = 0;
        T = n * n * 2 + 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                mf.addEdge(S, (i-1)*n + j, sci[i][j]);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                mf.addEdge(n*n + (i-1)*n + j, T, ca[i][j]);

        for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x)
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y)
                for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx)
                    for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny)
                        if (sci[x][y] != 0 && ca[nx][ny] != 0) {
                            if (dp[t][x][y][nx][ny] != 0)
                                mf.addEdge((x-1)*n + y, n*n + (nx-1)*n + ny, INF);
                        }

        int ans = mf.sap(S, T);
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
